headline: Miami and Michigan Seek Offensive Spark in Desperation Clash
subhead: Two struggling programs meet with bowl hopes fading fast.

xFactor.why: Miami's secondary must pressure Michigan's passing game early to avoid another blowout scenario like what Arkansas just inflicted.

keyMatchup: Miami's run defense versus Michigan's ground attack will determine field position and clock control in a game both teams desperately need to stay competitive.
body: Both programs enter this Week 12 showdown at the edge of the abyss. Miami limped out of Penn State with a three-point loss that at least showed some offensive competence, while Michigan got dismantled 34-16 by Arkansas—a result that exposed serious gaps in execution and discipline. These are two teams searching for any semblance of momentum heading into the final stretch, and the margin between survival and disaster is razor-thin.

Miami's recent loss was competitive; Michigan's was not. That gap in competitive bearing suggests the Hurricanes may have slightly more psychological resilience entering this contest. Both offenses rank near the bottom of the league, so whoever can establish even a basic running game and avoid critical turnovers should control the outcome. The staff that cleans up execution and penalties most effectively will likely escape Ann Arbor or Miami with a much-needed win.
